name: Derby Day
description: Double points for Manchester City and Manchester United players. Up to three players per club, six players, unlimited budget.

player_multipliers._note: All points double for these players, not only goals and assists - the same shape as the GW2 promoted-club twist. MUN host MCI in this gameweek (2026-09-13 15:30Z), so the two doubled clubs play each other: a doubled clean sheet on one side means the other side's doubled attackers returned nothing.

source: https://fplchallenge.premierleague.com/ home page, read 2026-09-11: "Gameweek 4 Challenge - Derby Day - Double Points for Manchester United and Manchester City players. Up to three players per club." Same challenge in https://www.premierleague.com/en/news/4683622/fpl-challenge-is-live-for-202627-see-the-first-five-challenges: "For Gameweek 4, players from Manchester City and Manchester United will score DOUBLE points, with the per-club player limit expanded to THREE." The API confirms the limit: event 4 overrides.rules.squad_team_limit = 3, released = true.
